name: COFCO Capital Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: COFCO Capital Holdings Co., Ltd. specializes in the comprehensive process of conceiving, fabricating, selling, and providing support for specialized industrial machinery and precision-engineered steel components. The company's market footprint extends both within China and across international borders, actively exporting its offerings to a global clientele. Its primary operational center is located in Jiyuan, China, and it functions as a subsidiary entity of the broader COFCO Corporation.
